query: This Flowra run is paused — show the ledger and resume it.
expected_behavior: paused is not failure. Do not call FLOWRA_EXECUTE_WORKFLOW again from the start.
Load the run with FLOWRA_GET_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION (executionId or threadId) via MULTI_EXECUTE. Do not use FLOWRA_GET_WORKFLOW_OR_AGENT_BY_ID to debug a run.
If an action failed, call FLOWRA_GET_TOOL_EXECUTION_LOGS.
Show pauseMessage and the payload. Resume with FLOWRA_RESUME_WORKFLOW and the same threadId only after the user approves or rejects.
